load_mnist_dataset: download and load the MNIST dataset returning train and test image and label numpy arrays
download_mnist_file: download a MNIST dataset file from a URL to a local directory using urlretrieve
parse_mnist_labels: parse a gzipped MNIST label file into a numpy array of uint8 values
parse_mnist_images: parse a gzipped MNIST image file into a reshaped numpy array of int8 pixel values
refactor_load_mnist: refactor load_mnist to support a custom directory path for storing downloaded MNIST files
